property_summary: For every call to transfer(...) the reference contract always reverts when given an empty _tos array (i.e. transfer(...) cannot succeed with _tos.length == 0); the mutant that removes the require allows a successful return for some inputs with an empty _tos array, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the require to allow empty _tos arrays (remove the length>0 guard) so transfer can succeed where original would revert for empty arrays.
